nominal.note: Draft erosion assumes both shell contours reduce wall thickness over full height. Tool check is an axial cylinder versus port flange and a rectangular release blade. Snap beams, holes and intentional mating surfaces are excluded from the shell draft rule. No pressure, leak, fatigue or mold-release validation.
